scope: outer wire envelope; payload remains opaque; independent legacy profile only

facts.claim: Sender writes AF EF, transformed payload length as x86 little-endian word at offset2, transformed payload at4, EF AF suffix; callback sees length+6 bytes.
Receiver scans for first AF, needs8 bytes from that candidate, compares EF then MOVSX16 length, checks complete payload/trailer, consumes prefix+6+length.
No AF returns incomplete without consuming; AF followed by non-EF consumes through AF once8-byte guard passes. Complete bad trailer leaves native queue blocked.
Receive append cap0x40000; queue consumption is a separate helper.
Polling receive appends then invokes frame consumer; transformed received text reaches4f8a40. Outgoing sender invokes405110 before envelope construction.

independent_policy.payload_domain: 0..32767; writer word can represent65535 but receiver MOVSX unsafe for high-bit values, therefore independent writer/reader reject them
independent_policy.small_payload_guard: 0/1-byte payload envelopes encode as6/7 bytes; reader waits until8 candidate bytes available, does not flush at EOF
independent_policy.ownership: append copies input, frame owns payload, consumed/closed/error state wiped
independent_policy.malformed: complete bad trailer or high-bit length is terminal error and clears reader; differs from native -1/head blocking or undefined pointer access
independent_policy.input_budget: reject without changing previously queued bytes; arbitrary chunk framing, one event per next call
independent_policy.finish: caller drains then finishes; remaining noise/incomplete envelope => terminal incomplete error

api: createLegacyGameEnvelopeReader(): append(bytes), next(), finish(), close(), inspect()
